tool.name: Ambolt CRA checks (CLI and GitHub Action)
tool.description: Checks an SBOM (CycloneDX or SPDX JSON) against the NTIA minimum elements and the Cyber Resilience Act wording, with an optional OSV vulnerability lookup, and generates security.txt and a vulnerability disclosure policy. Command-line tool (npm) and GitHub Action. No dependencies; the SBOM is read locally.
